newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco refinery makes $14.2 mln profit.
newsitem.headline: Morocco refinery makes $14.2 mln profit.

text.p: Morocco's oil refinery Societe Cherifienne des Petroles, which was recently privatised, made a net profit of 134 million dirhams ($14.2 million) in calendar 1996, the company said on Wednesday.
The company said in a statement that net profit rose 67.5 percent over the 80 million dirham net consolidated profit of 1995. Turnover rose 17 percent to 2.8 billion dirhams.

Moroccan privatisation ministry sold its 73.9 percent stake in SCP, the country's second oil refinery, to Swedish-based Saudi Corral Petroleum Holding AB last month for 473 million dirhams, or the equivalent of 365 dirhams per share.
"These good results confirmed the continuing rising trend registered in recent years," the statement added.
Located in the northern town of Sidi Kacem, SCP has a capital of 245 million dirhams, and refines an estimated 20 percent of the country's oil product needs.
The French oil company Elf holds 20 percent of SCP capital and Total holds three percent. A minority stake is traded on the Casablanca stock exchange.
